title: ERC-20：代币接口与支出授权
description: 已核规范条款。智能合约代币通过标准 API 提供转移功能，持有人也可批准链上第三方支出代币。
editorial_body:

recommendation_reason: 用于核对转移与第三方支出授权的接口边界。

title: ERC-721: Non-Fungible Token Standard
description: Selected specification clauses checked. The specification tracks and transfers ownership of distinct NFTs and permits operators to manage a holder's NFTs.
editorial_body:
The checked portions are Abstract; Specification in the pinned version. The original title is Non-Fungible Token Standard.

The specification tracks and transfers ownership of distinct NFTs and permits operators to manage a holder's NFTs. It requires ERC721 and ERC165 interfaces, with exceptions stated in the text. Use it to trace ownership and operator permissions for individual tokens; the interface does not by itself establish off-chain rights.

title: EIP-1559：基础费与优先费
description: 已核规范条款。交易类型 0x02 分开表达最高总费率与最高优先费率。
editorial_body:
核读范围为固定版本中的 Abstract; Specification。对应原题为 Fee market change for ETH 1.0 chain。

交易类型 0x02 分开表达最高总费率与最高优先费率。基础费按父区块用量相对 gas 目标的关系调整，并被销毁。发送方支付的基础费与优先费合计受最高总费率约束。建议沿一笔交易区分报价上限与实际支出，再核对区块条件，不用单一费率代替整个费用结构。

阅读级别：spec_text，仅核上述章节。固定版本：dc5d5fa688b7fe87b95a907fcc128b4fde2f4d2f（https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/dc5d5fa688b7fe87b95a907fcc128b4fde2f4d2f/EIPS/eip-1559.md）。这是规范要求的阅读说明，不是完整通读、实施核验或安全审计，也不证明任何实现符合要求。
recommendation_reason: 为区分费用上限、基础费和优先费提供规范入口。

title: EIP-1559: Fee market change for ETH 1.0 chain
description: Selected specification clauses checked. Transaction type 0x02 separates the maximum total fee rate from the maximum priority fee rate.
editorial_body:
The checked portions are Abstract; Specification in the pinned version. The original title is Fee market change for ETH 1.0 chain.

Transaction type 0x02 separates the maximum total fee rate from the maximum priority fee rate. The base fee adjusts with the parent block's usage relative to its gas target and is burned; the sender's base and priority fees together are bounded by the maximum total fee rate. Trace one transaction's caps and actual payment alongside block conditions instead of collapsing the fee structure into one rate.

title: EIP-1559：ベースフィーと優先手数料
description: 指定した仕様の節を確認。取引タイプ 0x02 は最大総手数料率と最大優先手数料率を分けます。
editorial_body:
確認した範囲は固定版の Abstract; Specification です。原題は Fee market change for ETH 1.0 chain です。

取引タイプ 0x02 は最大総手数料率と最大優先手数料率を分けます。ベースフィーは親ブロックの使用量と gas 目標の関係で調整され、焼却されます。送信者が払うベースフィーと優先手数料の合計は最大総手数料率が上限です。単一の料率にまとめず、取引の上限値と実際の支払いをブロック条件と照らして追うと整理できます。

title: ERC-4337：UserOperation 与账户抽象
description: 已核规范条款。UserOperation 在独立内存池传播，由 bundler 打包后调用 EntryPoint 的 handleOps。
editorial_body:
核读范围为固定版本中的 Abstract; Specification/Definitions。对应原题为 Account Abstraction Using Alt Mempool。

UserOperation 在独立内存池传播，由 bundler 打包后调用 EntryPoint 的 handleOps。方案依靠上层基础设施，不修改共识层协议。signature 的验证由智能合约账户实现决定，Paymaster 可同意代付费用。适合沿操作提交到执行的路径划分责任，并另核每个账户和服务的验证与代付条件。

title: ERC-4337: Account Abstraction Using Alt Mempool
description: Selected specification clauses checked. UserOperations propagate through a separate mempool; bundlers package them for EntryPoint's handleOps.
editorial_body:
The checked portions are Abstract; Specification/Definitions in the pinned version. The original title is Account Abstraction Using Alt Mempool.

UserOperations propagate through a separate mempool; bundlers package them for EntryPoint's handleOps. The scheme uses higher-level infrastructure without changing the consensus protocol. Smart contract accounts determine signature validation, and a Paymaster may agree to pay fees. Follow an operation from submission to execution to assign responsibilities, then check each account's validation and each service's sponsorship conditions separately.

title: ERC-4337：UserOperation とアカウント抽象化
description: 指定した仕様の節を確認。UserOperation は独立した mempool で伝播し、bundler がまとめて EntryPoint の handleOps を呼び出します。

title: EIP-7702：EOA 代码委托与授权顺序
description: 已核规范条款。交易类型 0x04 通过授权元组，在 EOA 写入 0xef0100 加目标地址的委托标记，执行时加载目标代码。
editorial_body:
核读范围为固定版本中的 Abstract; Specification/Behavior。对应原题为 Set Code for EOAs。

交易类型 0x04 通过授权元组，在 EOA 写入 0xef0100 加目标地址的委托标记，执行时加载目标代码。元组须满足 chain_id 为 0 或当前链 ID，并核对授权账户 nonce。校验失败的元组会被跳过。授权列表先于交易执行处理，已处理的委托标记不会随之后的交易执行失败而回滚。分析签名风险时应分别追踪授权校验和后续执行。

阅读级别：spec_text，仅核上述章节。固定版本：dc5d5fa688b7fe87b95a907fcc128b4fde2f4d2f（https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/dc5d5fa688b7fe87b95a907fcc128b4fde2f4d2f/EIPS/eip-7702.md）。这是规范要求的阅读说明，不是完整通读、实施核验或安全审计，也不证明任何实现符合要求。
recommendation_reason: 直接核对授权元组、nonce 与执行失败后的委托状态。

title: EIP-7702: Set Code for EOAs
description: Selected specification clauses checked. Transaction type 0x04 uses authorization tuples to write a delegation marker, 0xef0100 followed by the target address, into an EOA; execution loads the target code.
editorial_body:
The checked portions are Abstract; Specification/Behavior in the pinned version. The original title is Set Code for EOAs.

Transaction type 0x04 uses authorization tuples to write a delegation marker, 0xef0100 followed by the target address, into an EOA; execution loads the target code. A tuple must use chain_id 0 or the current chain ID and pass the authority nonce check; invalid tuples are skipped. Authorization processing precedes transaction execution, and processed delegation markers are not rolled back if that later execution fails. Trace authorization validation separately from subsequent execution when studying signing risks.

title: EIP-7702：EOA のコード委任と承認の処理順
description: 指定した仕様の節を確認。取引タイプ 0x04 は承認タプルを使い、0xef0100 と委任先アドレスからなるマーカーを EOA に書き込み、実行時には委任先コードを読み込みます。
editorial_body:
確認した範囲は固定版の Abstract; Specification/Behavior です。原題は Set Code for EOAs です。

取引タイプ 0x04 は承認タプルを使い、0xef0100 と委任先アドレスからなるマーカーを EOA に書き込み、実行時には委任先コードを読み込みます。chain_id は 0 または現在のチェーン ID である必要があり、承認アカウントの nonce も照合します。検証に失敗したタプルはスキップされます。承認リストは取引実行より先に処理され、処理済みマーカーは後の実行が失敗しても巻き戻されません。署名リスクは承認検証と後続の実行を分けて追う必要があります。

title: ERC-4626：资产与金库份额

title: ERC-4626: Tokenized Vaults
description: Selected specification clauses checked. The specification defines deposit, withdrawal and balance interfaces for a vault with one underlying ERC20 asset and represents shares as ERC20 tokens.
editorial_body:
The checked portions are Abstract; Specification in the pinned version. The original title is Tokenized Vaults.

The specification defines deposit, withdrawal and balance interfaces for a vault with one underlying ERC20 asset and represents shares as ERC20 tokens. Shares and underlying assets are different quantities. Vaults may implement ERC2612 for share approvals; non-transferable vaults may revert transfer or transferFrom. Compare asset and share units before examining transfer restrictions. The interface provides no yield guarantee.

title: ERC-7540：异步金库请求与领取
description: 已核规范条款。规范用 Request 扩展 ERC4626，支持异步存入、异步赎回或两者。
editorial_body:
核读范围为固定版本中的 Abstract; Specification/Request Flows。对应原题为 Asynchronous ERC-4626 Tokenized Vaults。

规范用 Request 扩展 ERC4626，支持异步存入、异步赎回或两者。请求经历 Pending、Claimable、Claimed 状态，原有存取接口用于领取。异步存入的资产已由 requestDeposit 转入，deposit 与 mint 不再重复转入，previewDeposit 与 previewMint 须回退。核对金库流程时，应分别记录请求时点、可领取状态和实际领取，不能把发出请求当作立即完成存入。

title: ERC-7540: Asynchronous ERC-4626 Tokenized Vaults
description: Selected specification clauses checked. Requests extend ERC4626 for asynchronous deposits, redemptions or both.
editorial_body:
The checked portions are Abstract; Specification/Request Flows in the pinned version. The original title is Asynchronous ERC-4626 Tokenized Vaults.

Requests extend ERC4626 for asynchronous deposits, redemptions or both. They move through Pending, Claimable and Claimed states, with the existing deposit and withdrawal interfaces used for claiming. In asynchronous deposits, requestDeposit has already transferred assets; deposit and mint do not transfer them again, while previewDeposit and previewMint must revert. Track request time, claimability and the eventual claim separately rather than treating a request as immediate completion.

ERC4626 を Request で拡張し、入金・償還の一方または両方を非同期にします。リクエストは Pending、Claimable、Claimed の状態を取り、従来の入出金 API は請求に使われます。非同期入金では requestDeposit で資産が移転済みなので、deposit と mint は再度移転せず、previewDeposit と previewMint は revert する必要があります。申請時点、請求可能な状態、実際の請求を分け、リクエストだけで入金完了と扱わない確認が必要です。

description: 已核规范条款。规范扩展 ERC4626，让多个资产入口对应同一 share 代币。

title: ERC-7575: Multi-Asset ERC-4626 Vaults
description: Selected specification clauses checked. The specification extends ERC4626 so multiple asset entry points can use one share token.
editorial_body:
The checked portions are Abstract; Specification/Methods in the pinned version. The original title is Multi-Asset ERC-4626 Vaults.

The specification extends ERC4626 so multiple asset entry points can use one share token. The share method separates the ERC20 share token from the vault and supports a Pipe converting between two external tokens. Vaults implement ERC4626 excluding its ERC20 methods and events, and both vaults and share tokens must support ERC165. Check which asset, vault and share contract each entry point refers to; shared shares do not prove identical asset risks.

description: 已核规范条款。规范定义结构化类型数据的编码、哈希、签名及可扩展域分离。

title: EIP-712: Typed structured data hashing and signing
description: Selected specification clauses checked. The specification defines typed structured-data encoding, hashing and signing with extensible domain separation.
editorial_body:

The specification defines typed structured-data encoding, hashing and signing with extensible domain separation. The signing encoding combines 0x1901, domainSeparator and hashStruct and defines eth_signTypedData RPC. It explicitly does not provide replay protection itself. When examining application signatures, look separately for nonces, deadlines or other replay controls; structured presentation alone does not make an authorization safe to reuse.

description: Selected specification clauses checked. A Recipient accepts meta-transactions through a trusted Forwarder without protocol changes.
editorial_body:

A Recipient accepts meta-transactions through a trusted Forwarder without protocol changes. The Forwarder must verify signatures and nonces, then append the signer's 20-byte address to calldata; the Recipient recovers the effective sender and data.
